Name: Reptile Farm
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Gators and toads and snakes, oh my! 

Ever notice Stardew is rather lacking in reptile life? Here's your chance to amass some cold-blooded critters for your farm!

This mod adds 5 varieties of animals to Marnie's shop. They all live in the barn.

Alligators - come in 3 colors. They drop alligator teeth and scales

Snakes - come in 6 colors. They drop snake skins and snake "milk". (If they look familiar, that's cuz they're from another Chucklefish game, Starbound!)

Tegu lizards - come in 3 colors. They "produce" (read: steal) chicken eggs and drop lizard tails (don't worry, they grow back!) (These Tegus come from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9017]Pet Tegu[/url] by Siveran, which had open permission)
﻿
Toads - come in 3 colors. They produce bug meat and Cave Jelly. These toads come from SmollHooman's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9063]SH's Wild Animals[/url] which had open permission)

Frogs - come in 3 colors. They produce bug meat and River Jelly. These frogs also com from SH's Wild Animals mod.

Bearded Dragons - come in 4 colors. They produce bug meat and Cave Jelly. Bearded dragons also come from SH's Wild Animals mod

Turtles - produce bug meat and River Jelly. Turtles come from vanilla game assets

Enjoy!
